title: Capsum Gets a New Owner
summary: Chanel has sold its majority stake in the CDMO to Motion Equity Partners, while the founding CEO and management team retain a minority share.

extraction.key_fact: 샤넬이 CDMO 캡섬의 과반 지분을 모션 에쿼티 파트너스에 매각했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Chanel has sold its majority stake in the CDMO to Motion Equity Partners, while the founding CEO and management team retain a minority share.
